# Digitalizing for Cafes

> Multi-page Russian-language landing site for a cafe POS system. Built with Vite + SCSS + vanilla JS.

This project is a high-performance landing page featuring a modular architecture for both styles (SCSS) and logic (Vanilla JS). It follows BEM naming conventions and a desktop-first responsive design approach.

## Architecture

- [Project Instructions](AGENTS.md): Core guidelines, architectural overview, and development workflows.
- [JS Entrypoint](src/js/main.js): Main JavaScript entry point that imports styles and initializes modules.
- [SCSS Entrypoint](src/scss/main.scss): Central SCSS file managing the order of imports (abstracts, base, pages, layouts, components, utilities).
- [Package Configuration](package.json): Project dependencies, build scripts, and linting configurations.

## Modules

- [JS Feature Modules](src/js/modules/): Individual JavaScript files for specific features (e.g., burger button, form handling, sliders).
- [SCSS Components](src/scss/components/): Reusable BEM-styled UI components.
- [SCSS Layouts](src/scss/layouts/): Global structural styles for header and footer.

## Optional

- [Main HTML](index.html): The primary HTML structure of the landing page.
- [SCSS Variables](src/scss/abstracts/_variables.scss): Design tokens and theme variables.
- [SCSS Mixins](src/scss/abstracts/_mixins.scss): Reusable SCSS snippets for common styles.
